steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, the Vulpo was just sighted in this area.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: She's a sharp one. Practically stays in a new place every day. We investigated every place she's been and only figured out her approximate location.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Ingrid Venezia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Back in law school, my jurisprudence professor mentioned the name once, but it didn't even come to my mind last night.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: She told us Siracusa's cruel and conflictive atmosphere stems not from the local races here, but originates from the land itself...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Her rationale for how a gentle Vulpo could turn into a 'Vulpo even more ruthless than a wolf' after coming to Siracusa—and our laws are to rein in this sort of inevitable evolution.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Ingrid has more than twenty criminal records spread out between five nomadic city courts, each one corresponding to a spike in the Venezias' influence in the area...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: The famiglia has also always tried their best to keep her away from any revenge killings or court trials.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Rumor has it that Venezia senior even favored her more than his actual daughter.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: But in 1094, Ingrid suddenly left the famiglia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Left?

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: More accurately, she defected.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Venezia Trucking expanded their business to Terni then. Famiglia Tancredi was actively provoking the other side so they could plunder the local alloy deposits. The conflict intensified and eventually escalated into a gang war.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: The two Grey Hall famiglie were practically locked in a cycle of violence, and they even tried to put a hit out on Venezia senior...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Ingrid went into a killing spree, taking down more than ten of the Tancredis' made men.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Strange thing is, when Signora Sicilia personally came down and the two famiglie finally managed to start negotiations... Ingrid ignored the don's order to stop and continued her slaughter.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: I saw the records. The stuff she did... freaks me out even now.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Motive?

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Unclear.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Anyway, Ingrid basically challenged Signora Sicilia's authority with her actions, but vanished without a trace after that...

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: The entire Famiglia Venezia was blamed for this, and they almost met the same fate as Famiglia Texas.
The young judge imagines the Vulpo taking lives in the city, along with the smile that never left her face while they were at the winery yesterday.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Judge?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: A top killer from a famiglia, with many murder cases under her hands, suddenly appearing in Nuova Volsinii... right in time for Carnevale. We can't let her move as she pleases.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The famiglie here have all passed their background checks. Every member and weapon is registered and strictly regulated...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Someone like Ingrid is likely to act as another person's blade, regardless of whether she knows it or not.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We need to capture her first at all costs.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Yes. But... this area is huge. We still haven't managed to nail down her exact location yet.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If the information about her and her daughter is accurate, I'm sure she's headed towards a certain place.
Lavinia looks toward an inconspicuous sign not far away from them—'Rhodes Island Branch Office'.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: *sigh* The shop I often go to source materials is about to close for Carnevale.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: We'll need to update our reserve count on the terminal in advance.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: How's Vigil's doing? The landship dispatched a doctor to the hospital, but we haven't gotten any news since.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Dunno. The support mission this time has a high confidentiality level, and I don't have enough clearance to check his latest data.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I looked for Penance earlier, and she seems hesitant to share too much to us.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Let's trust our colleagues. We just need to complete our support logistical work.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Erm... There's a new notice on PRTS: 'Approved: Application to increase security level of Nuova Volsinii branch office', requested by...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Penance?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: There's a Rhodes Island safehouse here too... I see these Rhodes Islanders are like tuskbeasts. Dig many hideouts for themselves.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: *huff*... Don't attract any attention... Focus on recovering my strength—
*stomach groans*
Lunacub huddles between the ceiling and a ventilation duct, rubbing her empty belly with some frustration.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: ...I smell something sweet. Like honey.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: No, I need to focus. Got to sharpen my arrows while time is on my side—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I can eat first? But Agnese, didn't you say I have to be patient while I'm out hunting—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: My stomach can wait. I don't want you to lose.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Yup, I'll do everything else as you say, except for this. I don't want to let you down.
Lunacub hides in a corner, grabbing her bow and taking aim, almost instinctively.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: (Not a wolf. It's the kind of smell that Agnese hates.)

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: My nose isn't sharp enough to tell which one you are.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: But I know one of you is hiding in here.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You have ten seconds to leave this place. I'll wait for you outside.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Of course, it won't be hard for me to get around Rhodes Island employees to deal with you, but I'd rather not take the risk.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: So do me a favor. I'm trying my best to avoid leaving a bad impression on Lisa's coworkers.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I guess there's no more room for discussion—

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: A timely response. Interesting.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I suggest everyone put their weapons down.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: We've sealed the exits and activated all defense systems, so let's not make it any worse.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You set a trap for me?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Um... trap?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: It's just our regular security system at work.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Rhodes Island truly does not disappoint.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I assure you we're just protecting our own assets, miss.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: If the two of you could just wait a moment. The government will soon take things over from here.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: (Agnese, any ideas to get out of here? Agnese? Agnese... where are you?)

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We meet again, Ingrid.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: An unregistered visitor using a deadly weapon inside the city and vandalizing assets belonging to a legitimate company.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This time, you will have to come with me for an investigation.

spans.text: have to come with me for an investigation.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: And her?
Ingrid points at the girl who is still warily observing the situation developing around her.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: *sigh* We'll bring her along too.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese needs me.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: My hunt hasn't ended yet—
*stomach groans*
Everyone present turns to look at the source of the sound in unison.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: We'll get some food for you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Please, Signora Venezia. I don't wish to have the police act.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You want to protect her?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That is something for us to consider.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Alright, I'll come along. Only because you have my respect, Lavinia.

steps.name: Government Clerk
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, we're done with their pre-registrations.

steps.name: Government Clerk
steps.text: The rest of the process will be a breeze.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I said I'd cooperate, didn't I?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Leon told me about the game. You're in it too? Like her?
Lavinia looks at Lunacub.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Um, grazie mille for the honey biscuits.
Lunacub gobbles down her food as she keeps her eyes on everyone around her.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: So can I leave already? I have important things to do.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I'm no Fang, Lavinia. I told you, I'm just a mother in search of justice for her daughter.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hands off my bow!

steps.name: Government Clerk
steps.text: Judge, shouldn't we take her in? What if—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Remember me, Lunacub? Don't be rash, the police have already locked down this area.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Stay by my side. It'll be good for all of us. You can trust me.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I only trust Agnese.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Bernardo trusted me too.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: ...He's dead.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But his heir still lives.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I-I want to ask Agnese about this. But she hasn't been replying me for a while.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Stay with me, and you won't have to worry about getting into trouble. You'll have more time to contact Agnese too.
Ingrid quietly watches Lavinia as she persuades Lunacub.
The girl covered with a wild scent is hesitating. Ingrid knows an opportunity approaches.
If Lavinia can get Agnese's Fang under control, that will save Ingrid a lot of trouble.
The other Fang in hiding will surely come to her.
If you notified me earlier, this misunderstanding we're having here could have been settled in a much more decent manner.
Long time no see, sorella.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Signor Antonio.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Salve, Judge Lavinia. I made my way here just to submit the required documents and company testimonials, to help Ingrid Venezia complete her identification registration.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Leave this to me, sorella. We Venezias have always been happily cooperative with the government.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Your Honor, I know Ingrid's recent actions have violated a couple of rules of Nuova Volsinii, but I believe none of them are serious?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Let's see: not registering on entry, using personal weapons in public spaces... oh, and vandalizing legitimate company assets, yes?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Regarding the last item, Venezia Trucking will discuss compensation with the involved company as soon as we are able.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Signor Venezia, you can just tell me what you want.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Bail. I'd like to bring my sister back home, everyone misses her so much.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Wait, Antonio. I didn't want to drag the family in. There's no need for you to fight with city hall for me.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It's not just for you, sorella. It's for the famiglia too. You may have your own opinions, but papa and I still regard you as one of ours.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I want every Venezia to have a clean record in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Besides, there's no need to censor the word 'famiglia' here. Everyone knows it's the foundation of our very lives. Nuova Volsinii just wants a declaration from us.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Forgive me for my candidness, Judge Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I understand, your company's enduring cooperative nature with us relies on both sides being honest with each other.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: However, are you sure you want to stake the entire company's reputation to vouch for Ingrid, Signor Venezia?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Why not? It would have been the same with the old don.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Venezia Trucking will ensure the government that Ingrid Venezia will not step afoul of the law during her post-bail probation period.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: If you find any clear evidence of her doing so, I will personally accompany her at court.
Lavinia's head hurts. The other party's request does comply perfectly with standard procedures.
Ingrid does have a right to be released on bail, but... it shouldn't happen now.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I can't refuse you, can I? You really excel at dealing with the government, Signore.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Because I know you are not the inflexible type.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: After all, I can clearly tell you know our little friend here with the huge bow, and you have no problems with her actions either.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Andiamo, sorella.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Someone else will handle the formalities for you. I know why you're back in Siracusa, we can help you with Lisa's matter.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Venezia... are you involved as well?

steps.name: Flustered Government Clerk
steps.text: —Aaaaahh!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Flustered Government Clerk
steps.text: I-I just got bitten by a tuskbeast that came out of nowhere!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: A tuskbeast?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Wait—where's Lunacub?

steps.name: Flustered Government Clerk
steps.text: Isn't she right next to—
She suddenly freezes—there is only air.

steps.name: Flustered Government Clerk
steps.text: Where did she go?

steps.name: Calm Officer
steps.text: Your Honor, we just engaged with a very agile individual.

steps.name: Calm Officer
steps.text: She was mumbling something about wilderness survival skills and an Agnese, we couldn't stop her... we sent some men to chase after her.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I got it.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: To be honest, I thought we'd never get a chance to see each other again until the famiglia started considering an expansion in Higashi, sister.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Stop calling me that, Antonio. We were never that close, and I'm no longer part of the family.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Judging from their attitude towards you, I see you'll be the next don.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You're looking more and more like the Don—not just your attitude, but your appearance as well.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Your ears and tail... Did you become more like Bella after your marriage, or have you gotten some work done?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Ingrid, why are you still like this...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You don't like it when people make fun of you, but you don't hold back when you're on the offensive.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Really now?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It's been a while, Ingrid. Papa and I missed you very much.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: He took you in and raised you as his own. When I joined the famiglia you were the one he trusted the most. He loved you as much as his own daughter.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: But the chap who fled here from Bolívar and became a hired thug to avoid starving to death? He didn't know a soul here, and could only tuck his tail and try his best.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Combat wise? Within the wolves, he wasn't any much stronger. So what could he possibly offer such a big famiglia in exchange for a place of his own?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Be it a Vulpo's compassion for a Perro, or the most reliable member of the famiglia doing it to appease her subordinates...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Basically, I wouldn't be standing here today if you hadn't helped me out.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You're over-thinking it.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: The Don cares about many things, but decency will always top the list no matter what. He'll never let family members exclude or fight each other.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: That wasn't my point, Ingrid.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I have to become Venezia Junior. This is my way of repaying what you did.

spans.text: to become Venezia Junior. This is my way of repaying what you did.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Six years ago, the day we fought the Tancredis and it felt like it would never end—you were the one who pulled me out from the pile of corpses.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I didn't do it for you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Lisa was only nine when she was hurt during the Tancredis' plot to assassinate the Don.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I don't care who orchestrated it. They should all perish.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: ...I know. I'm just admitting the fact that you saved my life.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Enough with the niceties. Both you and him have more important things to deal with.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: When I had just arrived here, I was collecting information when I overheard some wise guys at the bar bragging about your achievements.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: 'Antonio went with Venezia Senior and asked to meet with Signora Sicilia, and then sat at the negotiation table alone. Even though the other party gave him a hard time, he still managed to save a factory in Terni for the Venezias.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Look at you now. Got what you wanted.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It should've been you instead.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: But you insisted on going your own way and escaping Siracusa.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You may be a Vulpo, but I personally think you're more of a Siracusan than anyone else.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I've never forgotten the first time I followed you on a mission. We were ambushed in an alley, and a blade scratched your face. There was so much blood I wanted to send you to the hospital...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: But you said, our opponents think we're dead, so now is the best time to get them while their guard is lowered.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: 'You need to be fiercer, Perro.'

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: 'Living in a Siracusan famiglia means living life on the edge. You may lose everything at any moment.'

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: 'If you aren't prepared for this, then you better run back to Bolívar.'

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You always did everything better than the rest of us. You were my role model.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: So I don't care that you went on a trip and got married to a Higashinese man whom we've never met, or how you suddenly came back with Lisa in tow...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Don't get me wrong, I was fond of her, as well as papa and Bella... We gave her the best room and best teachers, we loved her as much as we loved you.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Papa often said the ragazzina would only make you stronger, instead of becoming your weak spot—

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Enough, Anton. Too many words. Sei fastidioso.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I didn't come back to wax nostalgic with you. Just tell me who hurt Lisa.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: ...You won't even wait until you see our father again?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Come back and help me out, Ingrid.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: What happened with Lisa is something the famiglia owes you. I'll definitely help you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I don't want anything to do with the family anymore. It's the best way forward for both sides.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Listen to me, we took great pains to establish a firm foundation in Nuova Volsinii. A brand new city, a new set of laws. There are many things to attend to.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Papa's old, and there hasn't been any youths worth pinning his hopes on. You know what he's like. He's not willing to change, but he's much less willing to see the famiglia regress.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: And then Bella's death dealt such a big blow to both him and I—

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Bella's dead?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Happened last year. You know she was never in the best of health.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I really need you with us, Ingrid... I think papa wants you home even more than I do.
Ingrid is silent. She merely casts a cold stare at the Perro before her.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Come back to us, and I'll tell you the truth about Lisa's injury.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I see there's nothing else to discuss.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Grazie mille for separating me from Lavinia on your own accord, but it was not necessary.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I had my own plans in mind.
Ingrid waves her hand, and turns to leave.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Ingrid, I knew you were back on your first day here.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The famiglia has never forgotten you.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Also... I saw the famiglia crest stashed away in your pocket. You're not as sure as you make yourself look.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The Venezias' doors are always open to you.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Well... You're already a true-blue Siracusan yourself.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You honor me.
Wait, Ingrid. Got news you might be interested in.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I know you two. Saw you both next to Antonio the other day.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: I believe I made myself clear with him earlier.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We know where Luchino de Montano is. We bagged him and brought him back to the Venezia residence in the city.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We can't take you to him, but we can tell you where exactly he is inside.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Why sell out your own employer?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: And how do you know what Umberto asked me to do?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Uh... I don't know how to explain this properly!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Wait, he ain't lying to you.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Minchia. Someone made us do this, okay? We don't know how you're linked to the tailor boy, we're just trying to survive!

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Survive?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Explain everything clearly or you can kiss your lives goodbye.
Ingrid knows how to use her blade well. She knows when to take someone's life with it, and when to make people believe so with it.
Unfortunately, Capone and Gambino have no idea she's using it for the latter right now.
Che noia. I thought you were serious at first.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You goddamn pazza!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: He's got a sturdy neck, so you might have to put your strength into it.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: ...Lappland Saluzzo?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh. You know me?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: We met once.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You've grown up so much, but I remember that smile of yours.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We've met?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I don't remember that.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Ten years ago, in Brunello. I was mediating a dispute between your Famiglia Saluzzo and the Morettis.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Your family was obviously on the losing side, and you were just a teenager then—the successor bearing Alberto's highest expectations. But what you really wanted to do...

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Was to seize an opportunity to bury the famiglia six feet under.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha. I was young and frivolous then.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: People mature. Now all of Siracusa is my enemy.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: You really are insane.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Must be sarcasm with that smile on your face.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Why tell me this? Is there a conflict of interest between the Saluzzos and Venezias?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why would I care about the Saluzzos' fate?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The little tailor owes me two suits, is all. When you see him, do pass on the reminder.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's rude to keep your clients waiting.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: ...I'll ask him about it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And just so you know: You're such a boring Siracusan, but quite amusing as a mother.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I see even messenger work is an arduous task for you two.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you want us to do stuff for you, let us tell the boss first at least. I don't want the Venezias after me.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What else do you want from us, Lappland?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Wow. I didn't think the both of you would be so willing to work for me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Relax, I'm not interested in poaching men from the Perro.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just be good and stay by his side. Help him out when he needs it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Of course, I'll reward you by divulging where the missing truck is, the one you have been looking for.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...Just what are you up to?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm making you both look good to Venezia Junior, of course.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't you deserve it?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino. I got a feeling we're gonna end up fed to the fins for real this time.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Yup.
